title: neophloga scottiana
intro: Neophloga scottiana, commonly known as the "Horned Passionflower," is a species of flowering plant in the Passifloraceae family, native to the tropical regions of South America. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include the treatment of anxiety, insomnia, and inflammation due to its sedative and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Neophloga scottiana include its ability to act as a muscle relaxant and a sedative, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as epilepsy and anxiety disorders. The bioactive constituents of Neophloga scottiana include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
